scientific_limitations: All formulas concern the simple Möbius ladder on 2n labelled vertices with n>=2 antipodal pairs.
The full polynomial is a 16-state exact transfer identity; it does not cover other cubic graph families.
Historical priority is provisional; a relevant 2021 primary paper was not retrieved in full.
title: Rational 1-limited domination census of Möbius ladders
